items.title: Government sues 3M Australia for $2 billion over PFAS contamination
items.description: The Commonwealth is launching its largest-ever legal claim, suing the manufacturer of a firefighting foam containing PFAS chemicals that contaminated 28 Defence Force bases across Australia.

items.title: Iran and US trade air strikes after Trump dismisses Hormuz deal
items.description: The US president has repeatedly said the end of the war is close, but told media at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday he was not yet satisfied by the negotiations and the US is not discussing easing sanctions, one of Tehran's key demands.

items.title: AFP defends public arrest of Ben Roberts-Smith
items.description: The Australian Federal Police has detailed intelligence surrounding Ben Roberts-Smith's arrest, pushing back against criticisms of its public nature.

items.title: Nationals pull election stunt as tax debate heats up
items.description: This week a few people got a grilling at Senate estimates, the tax debate heated up and whispers of a new centre-right party fluttered through the press gallery.

items.title: Work about to begin on $3.6b Olympic Stadium as protesters vow to stay put
items.description: The Queensland government wants site work to begin on Brisbane's $3.6 billion Olympic stadium on Monday as residents plan a court challenge and Indigenous protesters refuse to move.

items.title: Australian to join 'scary as hell' mission to rescue Laos villagers from cave
items.description: A diver describes the "emotional moment" when he found a group of men alive after they were trapped for more than a week in a Laos cave, while a South Australian renowned for his ability to navigate tight spaces joins the rescue mission.

items.title: Lawyer says Joshua Brown will admit to childcare centre sex crimes
items.description: Joshua Brown, who has been charged with 156 offences, including sexual assault, has appeared in the Melbourne Magistrates' Court via video link.

items.title: ABC appoints Reuters exec Simon Robinson as news director
items.description: Senior Reuters executive Simon Robinson takes over from former director Justin Stevens who announced his resignation on Wednesday after four years in the job.

items.title: Young police officer's death raises questions about mental health support
items.description: An inquest into the death of a NSW Police recruit who was less than three months into the job hears differing opinions about whether it was related to his work.

items.title: 'Unfair' Women's Origin timing criticised as Blues sweep Maroons aside
items.description: The captains of New South Wales and Queensland question the timing of the Women's State of Origin series after the Blues completed an historic clean sweep.

items.title: Meet the Iranians who gather every night outside Khamenei's house
items.description: Outside the Tehran compound that was home to now-dead Iranian supreme leader Ali Khamenei, hundreds of his supporters gather every night to mourn the only leader many of them have ever known.

items.title: Saints' tough loss made worse as midfielder injures Achilles
items.description: Hawthorn consolidates its top four spot with a big win over St Kilda, as the Saints lose Sam Flanders to a potentially serious Achilles injury.

items.title: Greens signal willingness to help Labor push capital gains changes through in weeks
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers introduced the bill to parliament on Thursday, which the government hopes to pass before the winter recess.

items.title: Shopping habits to help reduce your grocery spend
items.description: Small changes to the way we approach our meal planning can make a big difference to the overall cost.

items.title: 'Those guys are gonna disappear': ICAC reveals 'Pink Ladies' texts
items.description: Messages obtained by the NSW corruption watchdog have revealed discussions by a group of long-time Sydney local government officials about plans to secure senior positions for themselves and friends at City of Parramatta Council.

items.title: Why this photo has been terrifying the internet for years
items.description: Forget about slashers and body horror — the next evolution of fright stems from an fluorescent-lit room.

items.title: Outrage after women on history walk harassed by boys on e-bikes
items.description: Nine women say they were encircled, yelled at and filmed by a group of teenage boys on e-bikes while on a women's history tour of Wollongong.

items.title: The most influential female composers in history and today
items.description: From Hildegard von Bingen to Hildur Guðnadóttir, here are some of the most influential women of the music world in history and today.

items.title: Family 'burst into tears' after Lauren Huxley attacker denied parole
items.description: Robert Black Farmer was handed a 24-year sentence over the attempted murder of Lauren Huxley at her Northmead home in 2005.

items.title: Four Corners reporter Mahmood Fazal sacked by ABC
items.description: Mahmood Fazal has been sacked by the ABC following an internal investigation into an appearance on a podcast hosted by a former underworld figure, managing director Hugh Marks says.

items.title: Woman charged with joining IS remanded in custody
items.description: Police conducted searches at homes in Melbourne's north early on Thursday as part of ongoing investigations into people who have returned from Syria.

items.title: Drone with $1 million worth of contraband intercepted at Townsville prison
items.description: Queensland Corrective Services say the drone was carrying illicit drugs, syringes and a mobile phone.

items.title: IS-linked mother back in childhood bedroom in Sydney's south-west
items.description: The father of one of the returned Islamic State group-linked women says his daughter is "happy to be home" but exhausted after more than a decade stranded in Syria.

items.title: Ex-police officer admits sharing bed but denies rape, court hears
items.description: A former South Australian police officer says he got into bed with a woman while she was sleeping and caressed her thigh soon after she rejected his advances, but denies raping her, a court has heard.

items.title: No new evidence in Gus Lamont search, but police 'won't give up'
items.description: A renewed search for missing four-year-old boy Gus Lamont has failed to uncover additional evidence, police reveal.
